# James Studio

> James Studio is a minimalist web development studio based in Manchester, United Kingdom. We design and build fast, custom-coded websites, browser extensions, and full-stack web applications — no bloated frameworks, no heavy agency overhead.

James Studio specializes in frontend development, backend architecture, and SEO/conversion optimization. Sites are hand-coded for speed and simplicity, typically achieving load times under one second.

## Services

- Frontend Development — responsive, high-performance user interfaces
- Backend Development — server-side architecture, APIs, and databases
- SEO & Conversion — semantic structure and performance auditing for search ranking

## Pages

- [Home](https://jamesstudio.uk/): Overview of services, portfolio, and contact form
- [ClassCharts Improver](https://jamesstudio.uk/projects/classchartsimprover.html): Browser extension enhancing the ClassCharts platform for students and teachers
- [Scouts Car Wash](https://jamesstudio.uk/projects/scoutscarwash.html): Website built for a car wash business
- [Montecure Dogs](https://jamesstudio.uk/projects/montecuredogs.html): Website for a dog-related business

## Contact

Inquiries are handled via the contact form on the homepage. Project briefs receive a development framework estimate within 24 hours.
